descriptions.description: Bulbophyllum micropetalum is a species of plant in the family Orchidaceae.Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families It is found in Cameroon and the island of Bioko in Equatorial Guinea. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist montane forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.
